title: What about you?
goal_hi: Jawab dene ke baad wahi sawal wapas poochh kar baat aage badhana.

forms.positive: I'm a developer. What about you?
forms.negative: I'm not very busy today. What about you?
forms.question: What about you?

pattern.note_hi: Same question wapas poochhne ka short tarika.

examples.en: I'm a developer. What about you?
I usually commute by bike. What about you?
examples.hi: Main aam taur par bike se jaata hoon. Tum?

examples.en: I like cricket. What about you?
I'm not very busy today. What about you?
examples.hi: Main aaj zyada busy nahi hoon. Tum?

examples.en: I'm mostly remote. What about you?
examples.hi: Main zyadatar remote kaam karta hoon. Tum?

words.example_en: I arrived early for the event.
words.example_hi: Main event ke liye jaldi pahuncha.

words.example_en: I'm reading a book about design.
words.example_hi: Main design par ek kitab padh raha hoon.
Main Sunday ko dinner banata hoon.

dialogue.title: At the work event
dialogue.context_hi: Work event me naye bande se milna. Har answer ke baad sawal wapas poochho.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I'm Meera. I don't think we've met.
lines.hi: Hi, main Meera. Lagta hai hum mile nahi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hi Meera, I'm Azim. I'm a developer. What about you?
lines.hi: Hi Meera, main Azim. Main developer hoon. Tum?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm a designer. Do you work at the Edone office?
lines.hi: Main designer hoon. Tum Edone office me kaam karte ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I'm usually there three days a week. What about you?
lines.hi: Haan, main aam taur par hafte me teen din wahan hota hoon. Tum?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm mostly remote. It's a busy office, right?
lines.hi: Main zyadatar remote hoon. Office busy hai, na?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It is. Are you staying for the talk?
lines.hi: Hai. Tum talk ke liye ruk rahi ho?

sound_focus.tip_hi: Question intonation: 'What about YOU?' me you par awaaz upar. Har follow-up sawal ke end me pitch badhao.

scenario.setting_hi: Work event me naye colleague se milna. Har jawab ke baad sawal wapas.

turns.prompt_en: Hi, I don't think we've met. What do you do?
turns.hint_hi: Developer ho — aur unse bhi poochho.
turns.model_en: I'm a developer. What about you?

turns.prompt_en: I'm a designer. Do you work at the Edone office?
turns.hint_hi: Haan, teen din office me — unse bhi poochho.
turns.model_en: Yes, I'm usually at the office three days a week. What about you?

turns.prompt_en: I'm mostly remote. Is your day busy?
turns.hint_hi: Busy hai, par pasand hai. Unse poochho kya woh talk ke liye ruk rahe hain.
turns.model_en: It's busy, but I like it. Are you staying for the talk?

turns.prompt_en: Yes, I am. Do you want to sit together?
turns.hint_hi: Haan, aage baithte hain — aur unse poochho.
turns.model_en: Sure. Let's sit near the front. What about you?

quiz.prompt: I'm not very busy today. What about ___?
